description: Check monthly building permits for new residential construction by geography. Returns count of authorized privately-owned housing units and construction activity trends.

category_code.description: APERMITS (annual rate, default) or PERMITS (monthly level). Pass "ALL" to get every residential-construction series for the month.

time.description: Month as "YYYY-MM" (e.g. "2026-04"), or "from 2026-01 to 2026-04" for a range. Defaults to the latest published month.

name: census_building_permits
